responsibility: Implements RTL downward store motion by applying lazy code motion on the reverse CFG to move equivalent stores closer to exits and eliminate redundant earlier stores. It interns candidate MEM store expressions in st_expr tables, computes local anticipatability, availability, kill, and transparency bitmaps, runs reverse-edge LCM to derive insertion and deletion maps, inserts moved stores on safe edges, deletes superseded block-local stores, and reports created/deleted store counts for this optional GCSE-related pass.
